name: Improved Favored Form
body:
One of your favored forms is more powerful than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Favored Form class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one of your favored forms to apply this feat to. All your favored form bonuses (Dex or Con bonus, skill bonuses, and favored terrain bonuses) are doubled when you assume this form. Once selected, the chosen form cannot be changed. However, if you swap the chosen favored form for another favored form due to leveling up, you may apply this feat to a different favored form.
